significance: A goddess temple at Haripurdhar in the Lesser Himalayan foothills of Sirmaur district, and one of the district's principal pilgrimage sites; it stays open to visitors year-round.
story: Tradition holds that Maa Bhangayani gave her blessing to Shirgul Maharaj, through which the king of Bagad and Guga Peer secured his release from Mughal captivity.
